title: 直壁短交叉伸手
description: 赛璐璐画面中，轻短交叉手动作与低位稳定脚点形成斜线。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original cel-shaded illustration of a fictional adult making a short cross-body hand reach on a low vertical bouldering line. One hand stays on a broad plum jug, the reaching arm crosses only modestly toward a nearby rounded edge, and both shoes stand on clearly separated positive footholds. The torso turns naturally with the reach; avoid tangled arms or extreme strain. Use a medium-wide three-quarter view showing the whole adult and uninterrupted padded floor. Clean dark contours, pale lavender wall planes, and yellow hold accents create a distinct graphic scene. Opaque clothing and credible anatomy are essential. Include no text, brands, leaps, or high exposure.
